title: 第828章 邪魔 这是人第827章 看来是本座想多了
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
“这方小世界是我们特意挑选的，里面的凡人很多，肯定能够让你们满意。”
殷护法接过玉匣，神识往里探了一下，随即满意地点点头。
有了这方小世界，等到噬魂邪魔将里面的几十亿人口全部吞噬了之后，便是又能够凝聚出不少的神魂本源出来。
交易完成得很顺利。
顺利到他甚至觉得之前浪费那么多时间去试探几只虫子简直是多此一举。
他正想把玉匣收起来，身后就飘来了阴冷邪魅的声音。
“桀桀桀，这几只虫子——”
殷护法连头都没回。
“随你处置。”
他顿了顿，又补了一句。
“快点解决，别耽误了回宗的时辰。”
邪影裂开嘴角，猩红的竖瞳缓缓转向废墟边那道被母蛭触手围住的身影。
它从半空中降下来，灰雾翻涌间身形缓缓逼近，每靠近一步，那股粘稠到让人窒息的精神威压就加重一分。
“桀桀桀，渺小的虫子，本座在你身上闻到了熟悉的气息，就让本座来看看，你之前究竟经历过什么吧。”
它伸出隐藏在灰雾之下的利爪隔空虚抓而起，顿时有一道气息从叶天澜头顶上剥离出来，形成了一道翻滚着的雾幕。
与此同时。
废墟边，那道一直低着头、浑身灰土、嘴角带血的身影忽然动了一下。
然后他抬起了头。
那张被灰尘和血污覆盖的脸上，之前所有的狼狈、疲惫、力竭在此刻尽数消散。
取而代之的则是一双亮得惊人的眼睛。

金芒如日！
其内迸发出的光芒璀璨得像两颗被点燃的星辰，穿透夜色，穿透漫天的灰雾，精准无比地锁定在了那浑身翻滚着邪恶诡异雾气的身影之上。
叶天澜嘴角缓缓上扬，扯出一个惊人的弧度。
“可算是——找到你了。”
那声音不大。
却像是惊雷炸响在每个人耳边。
邪影伸出的利爪顿在了半空中，竖瞳猛地收缩了一下。
它不清楚这个刚才还被母蛭追着打的蝼蚁为什么突然换了副表情，但直觉告诉它。
一股难以言喻的不安感正在从心中油然升腾而起。
也就在下一刻。
一股难以言喻的气息从废墟中冲天而起，像是一座沉寂了万古的火山在这一刻苏醒。
那气息之磅礴，浩瀚，霸道，让整座城池都在簌簌发抖！
演武场上的碎石被无形的威压碾成了齑粉，地面以叶天澜为中心寸寸龟裂，密密麻麻的裂纹如同蛛网般朝着四面八方蔓延开去！
大地在颤抖，虚空在哀鸣。
笼罩全城的灰白色毒雾在这股气息的冲击下像是遇到了克星，疯狂地翻涌、退缩、蒸发。
那两头母蛭本能地往后缩了缩，无数根触手不由自主地蜷曲起来，发出一阵阵尖锐刺耳的低鸣。
叶天澜从废墟中一步步走来。
每踏出一步，身上的气势就暴涨一截。
衣袍上的灰尘被无形的气劲震飞，露出下面一尘不染的白袍。
嘴角的血迹不知何时已经消失不见，取而代之的是一双亮得让人无法直视的金色瞳孔。
content_en:
"This small world was specially selected by us. There are many mortals in it, and it will definitely satisfy you."
Protector Yin took the jade box, looked inside with his consciousness, and then nodded with satisfaction.
With this small world, after the soul-eating evil demon devours all the billions of people in it, it will be able to condense a lot of soul sources.
The transaction was completed smoothly.
It went so well that he even felt that wasting so much time testing a few bugs was simply unnecessary.
Just as he was about to put away the jade box, a cold and evil voice floated behind him.
"Jie Jie Jie, these bugs——"
Protector Yin didn't even look back.
"As you wish."
He paused and added.
"Solve it quickly, don't delay your return to the clan."
The evil shadow opened the corners of its mouth, and its scarlet vertical pupils slowly turned towards the figure surrounded by the tentacles of the mother leech at the edge of the ruins.
It descended from mid-air, and the figure slowly approached amid the billowing gray mist. With every step closer, the viscous and suffocating mental pressure became stronger.
"Jie Jie Jie, you little insect, I smell a familiar scent on you, so let me take a look at what you have experienced before."
It stretched out its sharp claws hidden under the gray fog and grabbed it from the void. Suddenly, a breath of air peeled off from the top of Ye Tianlan's head, forming a rolling curtain of fog.
at the same time.
Beside the ruins, the figure with its head lowered, covered in dust and blood at the corner of its mouth suddenly moved.
Then he looked up.
On the face covered with dust and blood, all the previous embarrassment, fatigue, and exhaustion disappeared at this moment.
Instead, there was a pair of astonishingly bright eyes.
The golden light is like the sun!
The light bursting out from it was as bright as two ignited stars, penetrating the night and the gray fog in the sky, and locked on the figure with the evil and strange fog rolling all over its body with incomparable precision.
The corners of Ye Tianlan's mouth slowly raised in an astonishing arc.
"I've found you."
It wasn't loud.
But it was like thunder exploding in everyone's ears.
The evil shadow's outstretched claws paused in mid-air, and its vertical pupils shrank suddenly.
It didn't know why the ant, which was being chased and beaten by the mother leech just now, suddenly changed its expression, but its intuition told it.
An indescribable feeling of uneasiness was rising in my heart.
Just the next moment.
An indescribable aura rose into the sky from the ruins, like a volcano that had been silent for eternity awakening at this moment.
The aura was so majestic, vast, and domineering that it made the entire city tremble!
The gravel on the martial arts field was crushed into powder by the invisible pressure. The ground was cracked with Ye Tianlan as the center, and dense cracks spread in all directions like spider webs!
The earth is trembling and the void is wailing.
The gray-white poisonous fog covering the whole city seemed to have encountered a nemesis under the impact of this breath, surging, shrinking, and evaporating crazily.
The two female leeches shrank back instinctively, and their countless tentacles curled up involuntarily, emitting bursts of shrill, piercing lows.
Ye Tianlan walked step by step from the ruins.
Every time he took a step, his aura surged.
The dust on the robe was blown away by the invisible energy, revealing the spotless white robe underneath.
The bloodstain at the corner of his mouth disappeared without knowing when, and was replaced by a pair of golden pupils that were so bright that it was impossible to look directly into them.
